# Pinned dependencies for .github/scripts/check-expiry.py
#
# Versions verified against PyPI as of 2026-04-30 and OSV.dev advisory
# database. Each version covers the relevant CVEs flagged by
# OSV-Scanner against the prior pin.
#
# Dependabot (per .github/dependabot.yml `pip` ecosystem) will keep
# these current via weekly grouped PRs + per-CVE security PRs.

# 46.0.7 (Apr 8 2026) — covers GHSA-79v4-65xg-pq4g (≥44.0.1),
# GHSA-m959-cc7f-wv43 (≥46.0.6), GHSA-r6ph-v2qm-q3c2 (≥46.0.5).
# 46.0.7 is the latest stable. Compatible with PyJWT 2.12.x.
cryptography==46.0.7

# 2.12.1 (Mar 13 2026) — covers GHSA-752w-5fwx-jx9f (≥2.12.0).
# Latest stable. Requires Python ≥3.9 (workflow uses 3.12).
pyjwt==2.12.1

# 2.33.0 — covers GHSA-9hjg-9r4m-mvj7 (≥2.32.4) and
# GHSA-gc5v-m9x4-r6x2 (≥2.33.0). Both fixed in 2.33.0.
requests==2.33.0

# 6.0.2 — no CVEs flagged. Last release.
pyyaml==6.0.2
